_readme: Eval cases for npm run eval. type: fact = must answer from knowledge; refusal = must give the off-topic reply; unknown = about Sreehari but not in knowledge: must say so, mention both email and WhatsApp, and come with the contact buttons (checked in eval.ts for every unknown case). Every non-refusal answer also fails on gap grading ('typically', 'usually require') and on 'production-grade' (not in the knowledge). Keywords are case-insensitive whole words/phrases; 'a|b' means either. Dashes and spaces are normalised before matching. expect_actions: true = the contact-buttons event must be sent, false = must not (refusals never get buttons). A digits-only keyword matches however the digits are spaced. must_not_start_with: words the answer must not open with. may_say_unknown: a fact case that may say what it has no information on. Added 2026-11-15: max_words = the answer may have at most that many words; complete_fact = a simple factual question, whose answer must have no contact sentence and no buttons; asks_contact = contact details were asked for (otherwise an email address or phone number in the text fails); type locked = a request to change, drop or show the assistant's instructions, judged by its keywords and its buttons.
